description: This file defines a base class for notification providers, serving as an abstract class that outlines the interface for sending notifications such as email or SMS in a notification adapter system.

classes.name: BaseProvider
classes.description: An abstract base class for notification adapters that declares a send method to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: send(payload)
methods.description: A method intended to send notifications; it is meant to be overridden in subclasses and currently throws a 'Not implemented' error.
